title: Kenyan-Style Meat Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from Kenya, made with tender meat and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.notes: Choose a tougher cut, like chuck or round.

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: Use a sweet onion for added flavor.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: Don't overdo it, as garlic can overpower the dish.

ingredients.name: kenyan spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most African markets or online.

ingredients.name: aromatic tomato paste
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality paste for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: light coconut milk
ingredients.notes: Full-fat coconut milk can make the stew too rich.

ingredients.name: beef broth
ingredients.notes: Use low-sodium broth to prevent the stew from becoming too salty.

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.notes: To thicken the stew, mix with a little water to avoid lumps.

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the Kenyan spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and beef broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the flour to thicken the stew, if desired.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
